recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Handle any future Encounter.class cardinality or binding concerns through the later Encounter.class issue family; no follow-up is needed for the FHIR-5971 diet binding in core.
issue_request: FHIR-5971 was a Published PA change request from DSTU1 asking that Encounter.class not be mandatory and that the Encounter diet value set be an example set rather than a mandatory FHIR-defined set. The final resolution was Persuasive with Modification: change class cardinality to 0..1 and change the diet value set type to example rather than required.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by git commit 34bd650fb0b0f4c6d94f1dbdcfd3d7be1bc98325, which changed the historical Encounter spreadsheet so Encounter.class moved from 1..1 to 0..1 and the PatientDiet binding row was marked as an example value set.
additional_context: Encounter is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. Later Published issue FHIR-32341 deliberately changed Encounter.class to 0..* CodeableConcept with Preferred binding, implemented by 868cd2a065ac80c8aa8e31f2659b1fd690dde6ec. Later Resolved - No Change issue FHIR-39014 rejected making Encounter.class required again. FHIR-14157 reorganized Encounter and moved dietPreference to a top-level Encounter element, but the current binding remains Example.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative current source already has Encounter.class min 0/max * and Encounter.dietPreference bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/encounter-diet with strength example, so changing source would incorrectly override later PA decisions or duplicate existing correct source.
